rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recK1kdOaQXnNC9QZ.Bio: Parallel Mike hosts the Parallel Systems Broadcast, discussing 'alchenomics,' wealth psychology, precious metals, and building resilient parallel systems outside conventional debt-based finance; he appeared on InnerVerse to discuss these topics along with homesteading in Poland.
recK1kdOaQXnNC9QZ.Name: Parallel Mike

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Sound as Medicine and Ancient Resonance", "body": "Mike said he came to healing with sound through research into gold and temples, and he described measurements by archaeo-acoustician Paul Devereux that he said found 111 hertz in ancient chambers in Ireland and Malta. Chance described coherent vibration as having an effect on cellular biology and mental state, and he said light and sound were forms of vibration. He recommended experimenting with a weighted tuning fork such as the Sonic Slider. Chance also said he doubted marketing claims that 528 hertz repaired DNA, though he liked the numbers involved in the solfeggio frequencies."}, {"title": "The Biofield Anatomy and Stuck Energy", "body": "Chance described the biofield as roughly a six foot bubble around the body that he believed held a person's memories and beliefs. He explained that stuck energy formed around experiences or limiting beliefs a person did not want to feel, and that he swept a tuning fork inward from the outer edge to find it. Chance said the distance from the body marked when something happened, like the rings of a tree, and that regions of the field and the chakras carried specific meanings. He added that he sometimes used tarot to ask about early circumstances, and that the method worked remotely."}, {"title": "Trauma, Remote Work, and Spirit in Matter", "body": "Mike asked whether tuning could help with deep trauma without forcing a person to relive it. Chance answered that he set intentions before each session and told everyone present that trauma did not need to be re-remembered to be integrated. Asked how remote sessions worked, Chance said he believed the common split between a spirit world and a material world was mistaken, and that matter was condensed spirit. He described life force as one interconnected medium, comparing it to water in the glass, the air, and the cells, and said distance was a mental concept."}, {"title": "Ancient Sites, Metals, and the Holy Sailors", "body": "When Mike asked about the historical side of sound, Chance said he could not say what the ancients did with it, though he thought their architecture showed they knew something. He credited his friend Dylan Saccoccio with the term holy sailors and said he believed Phoenician seafarers linked burial mounds from Ireland to Malta. On metals, Chance said an inexpensive aluminum fork worked as well as a titanium one in his experience. He also read the brazen serpent story of Moses as a healing allegory, noting a Hebrew word he said meant both bronze and serpent."}, {"title": "The Body as Shield and Messenger", "body": "Mike raised the topic of EMF, and Chance replied that he considered the biofield a shield against dissonance, saying he believed a coherent field could ease sensitivities to things like Wi-Fi. Mike shared his experience with acupuncture and relayed what he had been told about emotions held in fascia, and Chance said he thought acupuncture and tuning worked in a similar way. Chance said he saw symptoms as messages and the body as a guardian angel, and he suggested learning the biofield anatomy so injuries could be understood through self-awareness."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: I joined Mike, host of the Parallel Mike Podcast, for episode 5 to talk about healing with sound, how my Biofield Tuning method works, and how the body speaks to us through symptoms.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "It soon became apparent to me that there is a whole area of study here related to healing with sounds that most people are simply not aware of. And more than that, the ancients particularly had a really in-depth knowledge of how to heal with sound.", "author": "Parallel Mike", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/67c2e5e8-3003-47f2-916f-f03ca30e320b/PARALLEL-MIKE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I make sure that everybody present is aware that the trauma that we might uncover in this method does not necessarily need to be re-remembered or even felt in a visceral way in order to be integrated and balanced.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Matter is spirit condensed, and if it's condensed and dense enough to be matter, that means there's a lot of spirit there. It's not lack of spirit, it's a lot of spirit. So your body is not something separate from your soul.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think really we see the water in the glass as separate from the water in the air, as separate from the water in your cells, but in a way it's one big interconnected pool, right?", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We know that even if you go into a church or a great cathedral, the acoustics in there are unique and also you've got gold everywhere, which is something that I know from my own study of gold.", "author": "Parallel Mike", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/67c2e5e8-3003-47f2-916f-f03ca30e320b/PARALLEL-MIKE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I don't advise people one way or the other apart from to tell them they don't need the most expensive tools to be effective with this work because it's really more about your mind and your awareness that is doing the job more than the physical tool.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Whenever science says something is useless, it means they have no idea what it's for.", "author": "Parallel Mike", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/67c2e5e8-3003-47f2-916f-f03ca30e320b/PARALLEL-MIKE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Your body is like literally your guardian angel, and it is telling you at all times exactly where your bottlenecks are in terms of energy or spiritual development. And the way that it communicates with you will be through dissonance or injury or pain.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
